title: RE-OPENING OF ONLINE APPLICATION OF SENIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT
text:
KEY LINES:
ln continuation of Commission's advertisement No. NO.PSC-R(A)/05/2020
Assistant (Sr.PA) is re-opened w.e.f. 04.06.2020 to 04-07-2020 till 4 PM

FULL TEXT:
ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PUBLIC SERYICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
NO.PSC-R(A)t0st2020 Dated Itanagar, the 3'd June,2020.
NOTIFICATION
ln continuation of Commission's advertisement No. NO.PSC-R(A)/05/2020
Dated 11tr' March' 2020 and subsequent Notification No. PSC-R(A)/28l2Olg Dated
2l-04-2020, this is to inform to all the aspiring candidates for the post of Senior Personal
Assistant (Sr.PA) under A.P. Civil Secretariat and Arunachal Pradesh Public Service
Commission that the online submission of application for the posts of Senior Personal
Assistant (Sr.PA) is re-opened w.e.f. 04.06.2020 to 04-07-2020 till 4 PM
(www.appsc.gov.in) after which the link will be disabled. The online submission of
application is extended for those aspiring candidates who could not submit their application
online due to nation-wide lockdown for COVID-19 pandemic.
I
